name: 26-convert-claude-messages-tools-degraded
description: The same tool exchange as 25 but with `useTools` false, which is the :355-373 degradation: every `tool_use` part becomes `text` carrying `JSON.stringify(input)` and loses `id` / `name` / `input`, and every `tool_result` becomes `text` carrying its `content` and loses `tool_use_id` / `content`. The stringify is the JS default, so the port must emit `{"city":"Kyoto"}` with no spaces after `:` or `,` -- that is what this fixture pins. Both degradations run over the *merged* array, so the two user turns are already one turn by then.
